svg.title: Cache competitive spawns
svg.desc: Numbered Cache spawns, with enlarged T and CT views. Gold: T. Blue: CT. Numbers follow setpos.gg. North is up. Short ticks show verified spawn facings. Linked numbers open available spawn pages.
